title: Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) for Retirement Cashflow
content: Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) allow periodic liquidations (monthly/quarterly) from mutual fund units. SWP advantages over traditional FD interest: 1. Tax Efficiency: Capital gains tax applies only to the gain component of withdrawn units, not the full principal. 2. Flexible Cashflow: Customizable withdrawal amounts aligned with monthly expenses. 3. Growth Potential: Unwithdrawn principal remains invested to combat inflation.
